task.description: WF-03 Step 2b re-gate after rework 1. Re-validate lib/letflow/design/iss0930-seed-service-task-endpoints.md. Your earlier FAIL is in handoffs/WF03-ISS0930-20261001/step-02b-code-design-validator.json (4 issues); the rework is handoffs/WF03-ISS0930-20261001/step-02-r1-code-designer.json. Independently verify each of the 4 issues is resolved AND that the fixes are themselves correct (e.g. that sort -V based version_is_older is portable to Git Bash/Linux and handles 1.0 < 1.1 < 1.10, that the test's String.to_existing_atom on method is safe, that the sample value does not trip the URL validator), and re-check no new gaps/implementation code were introduced. Modify nothing but this handoff. Work only in context.worktree. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to ELIXIR-DEV' on PASS.

result.summary: All 4 prior issues resolved and the fixes verified correct against code and a real sort run; no implementation code; no new gaps.

evidence.issue_1_node_struct: Design section 6 now names Letflow.Definitions.Graph.Node (graph.ex:156, enforce_keys [:id, :node_type]) built with id, node_type :SERVICE_TASK, string-keyed attributes; service_task.ex:185 pattern-matches %Graph.Node{id:, attributes:}. Correct.
evidence.issue_2_oq1: OQ-1 now cites VariableMerge.merge(seed_state.variables, decoded_body, nil) (engine.ex:2944, verified: nil validations). Statement accurate; residual risk described as semantic only.
evidence.issue_3_downgrade:
Section 5 step 3 is an explicit three-way (none/equal/older -> replace; equal -> skip; newer -> warn, skip, exit 0). Verified version_is_older basis: printf '1.10
1.1
1.0
1.9
1.2' | sort -V gave '1.0 1.1 1.2 1.9 1.10' (GNU coreutils 8.32 in Git Bash here); sort -V is standard GNU coreutils on Linux. Equal case handled before the helper so strict-before semantics are well defined.
evidence.issue_4_sample_and_method: Sample value fixed as "sample1" (alphanumeric, cannot alter scheme/host). Method: parse_method (service_task.ex:234-248) upcases then String.to_existing_atom rescued, accepts @valid_methods ~w(GET POST PUT PATCH DELETE)a; design compares String.to_existing_atom(String.upcase(fixture_method)) == config.method after asserting the string is in the allowed list, so it cannot raise for valid fixtures (atoms exist as ServiceTask is loaded by the same test calling it). Safe.
evidence.stub_resolver: Stub returns {:ok, [{:inet, {93,184,216,34}, []}]}; matches dns_resolver type in url_validator.ex and blocked_ipv4? (127/10/172.16-31/192.168/169.254 only) does not block it, so validate/2 returns :ok for https://httpbin.org/anything/... with sample1. Sample value passes the validator.
evidence.no_implementation_code: Whole file re-read: prose, tables, signature-level shell interface only.
evidence.no_new_gaps: Other sections (25-node table, host verification, file list, AC map) unchanged from the prior validated version. git status clean of edits by this validator.

notes_nonblocking: Section 6 calls 93.184.216.34 'documentation-range-safe'; it is a public example.com address, not an RFC 5737 range. Cosmetic wording only; behaviour is correct (not in any blocked range).
